videoDetails.title: Preaching the Good News in a Changing World—A Chat with Russ Whitfield, Aaron Chung, and Paul Kim
videoDetails.shortDescription: Join Russ Whitfield, Aaron Chung, and Paul Kim for a rich conversation on preaching—why it matters, how to prepare, and what it means to proclaim Christ in today’s world. Whether you’re new to ministry or a seasoned pastor, this discussion offers encouragement, practical wisdom, and fresh perspective for the pulpit.
videoDetails.author: Alliance for Mission and Renewal
